thesis.summary: 94% below its all-time high at 6.0x mcap/TVL with all fees burned and fee run-rate rising (7d at 1.13x of 30d). Lowest-conviction finalist.

regime.instructions: Which market regime does this snapshot show for this asset?

criteria.trending: Persistent directional move; trend_eff high, ema_gap_pct and returns agree
criteria.mean_reverting: Range-bound; moves fade, trend_eff low, volatility ordinary
criteria.high_vol: Large erratic moves without a clean direction
criteria.crisis: Disorderly sell-off: very large losses, extreme volatility, liquidity thinning

direction.instructions: Over the next 12 candles, which direction is this asset's price more likely to take?

criteria.long: Price more likely to be higher
criteria.short: Price more likely to be lower

setup_quality.instructions: How good is the long entry setup right now, given trend, pullback depth, volume and spread?
criteria: No setup: nothing favors an entry
Weak setup: one supporting signal, others absent or against
Good setup: several signals agree and risk is defined
Excellent setup: trend, timing, volume and liquidity all agree

risk_state.instructions: Given acct_dd_pct, day_loss_pct, exposure_pct and open_pos, what is the account's risk state?

criteria.safe: Losses and exposure are well inside limits
criteria.near_limit: Losses or exposure are approaching limits; add no size
criteria.reduce: Losses or exposure are at limits; cut risk

toxic_flow.instructions: Order flow is toxic: a new buy order here faces high adverse-selection risk (imbalance against it, widening spread, abnormal volume).
